A little reflection on this week: I felt like this lab was a very good refresher on SystemVerilog coding and testbench creation. With over three months of no-contact with SystemVerilog my skills have became a little rusty. Although this lab was a little bit bumpy at first due to all the Radiant issues, I was able to ramp back up pretty fast and got the 7-segment display working in one try. Plus, Quarto is pretty cool! Never have I typed so much Markdown at once, not even during my annoying Amazon internal tool development over the summer.
